fields.summary_ko.0: From June 19, 2023 to October 29, 2023, Samsung Electronics and SK Haiix share prices fell 34% and 45% respectively, yet average brokerage target prices rose 8.7% and 13.6%, creating severe disconnect.
fields.summary_ko.1: Some analysts shifted valuation metrics from PBR (relatively stable) to PER (earnings-sensitive), doubling target prices, but avoided accountability for these changes after subsequent price declines.
fields.summary_ko.2: Securities analysts are subject to fiduciary duty under Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act regulations, with prohibitions on lacking fairness or creating analysis without reasonable basis, which must be properly observed.
